title: Taking up piano; Kid Rena and others teaching him
summary: Piano was his first instrument, later banjo; Kid Rena, Kid Howard, Andrew Morgan and Chris Kelly showed him how to play. He describes where he was born and raised.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: When did you take up music? How old were you about when you started?
When I started to play, I was around in 21. 21. 27, something like that. 21, something like that. 21, something like that. 21.
Now, was piano your first instrument?
Piano was the first instrument. From that I'd taken up banjo, you see?
You'd never played anything else before? Never did play anything else before.

Piano was the first instrument. Never did play anything else before. But Rene and them would come to the house and teach me, you know? Show me how to play. And also, Kid Howard and Morgan, Andrew Morgan and all of them. And they had one boy, a fella there they called Wayback 2, had a little short horn. His name was Chris Kelly. Oh, yes. And Dauphine, you know, also in the same block as Kid Rene, on Dauphine there, Domingue, between Domingue and Phillip, rather. And, let's see, yeah.
You had a piano at your house?
Yeah, I had a piano at my house. I always did have a piano, you know?
Did you tell just what part of town you were born in and where you were raised and where

you lived? I was born in the back of town section around Taunty and Sedan, where I was born. And I was raised up around the back of White and Tupre and Lopez and Arlene. You know, got married two years before the war, before the war won.
Did you say Kid Rene lived down on Dauphine?

Yeah, him and his mother and his brother. Later he lived there. Later he lived there. When they had a dinner there, when Gaillet was playing trombone with him there. And the Burn West went big out when they begged him to go away when Louis Armstrong went away. They wanted him to go away also, but he didn't want to leave town. Otherwise he'd have been way up in the world, you know? He wouldn't mind being there.
